arxiv-1404-5760.title: Water isotopic ratios from a continuously melted ice core sample
arxiv-1404-5760.creator: V. Gkinis, T. J. Popp, T. Blunier, M. Bigler, S. Schüpbach, E. Kettner, S. J. Johnsen
arxiv-1404-5760.description: Abstract A new technique for on-line high resolution isotopic analysis of liquid water, tailored for ice core studies is presented. We built an interface between a Wavelength Scanned Cavity Ring Down Spectrometer (WS-CRDS) purchased from Picarro Inc. and a Continuous Flow Analysis (CFA) system.

arxiv-1502-02818.title: On the role of initial velocities in pair dispersion in a microfluidic chaotic flow
arxiv-1502-02818.creator: Eldad Afik 1,2,⋆ and Victor Steinberg 1 1 Department of Physics of Complex Systems Weizmann Institute of Science Rehovot 76100, Israel 2 Division of Biology and Biological Engineering California Institute of Technology Pasadena, CA 91125, USA
arxiv-1502-02818.description: Abstract Chaotic flows drive mixing and efficient transport in fluids, as well as the associated beautiful complex patterns familiar to us from our every day life experience. Generating such flows at small scales where viscosity takes over is highly challenging from both the theoretical and engineering perspectives.

arxiv-1611-08554.title: Asynchronous Distributed Automata: A Characterization of the Modal Mu-Fragment
arxiv-1611-08554.creator: Fabian Reiter
arxiv-1611-08554.description: Abstract We establish the equivalence between a class of asynchronous distributed automata and a small fragment of least fixpoint logic, when restricted to finite directed graphs. More specifically, the logic we consider is (a variant of) the fragment of the modal μ \mu -calculus that allows least fixpoints but forbids greatest fixpoints.

arxiv-2006-04544.title: Optimal Work Extraction and the Minimum Description Length Principle
arxiv-2006-04544.creator: Léo Touzo, Matteo Marsili, Neri Merhav, Édgar Roldán
arxiv-2006-04544.description: Abstract We discuss work extraction from classical information engines (e.g., Szilárd) with N N -particles, q q partitions, and initial arbitrary non-equilibrium states. In particular, we focus on their optimal behaviour, which includes the measurement of a set of quantities 𝚽 \boldsymbol{\Phi} with a feedback protocol that extracts the maximal average amount of work.

arxiv-2108-12658.title: Clusters in Markov Chains via Singular Vectors of Laplacian Matrices
arxiv-2108-12658.creator: Sam Cole, Steve Kirkland
arxiv-2108-12658.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Sam Cole, Steve Kirkland. Suppose that T T is a stochastic matrix. We propose an algorithm for identifying clusters in the Markov chain associated with T T . The algorithm is recursive in nature, and in order to identify clusters, it uses the sign pattern of a left singular vector associated with the second smallest singular value of the Laplacian matrix I − T .

arxiv-2202-13605.title: Quality-aware News Recommendation
arxiv-2202-13605.creator: Chuhan Wu Fangzhao Wu Tao Qi Yongfeng Huang
arxiv-2202-13605.description: Abstract News recommendation is a core technique used by many online news platforms. Recommending high-quality news to users is important for keeping good user experiences and news platforms’ reputations. However, existing news recommendation methods mainly aim to optimize news clicks while ignore the quality of news they recommended, which may lead to recommending news with uninformative content or even clickbaits.

arxiv-2210-00576.title: Robust phase-controlled gates for scalable atomic quantum processors using optical standing waves
arxiv-2210-00576.creator: Shannon Whitlock
arxiv-2210-00576.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Shannon Whitlock. A simple scheme is presented for realizing robust optically controlled quantum gates for scalable atomic quantum processors by driving the qubits with optical standing waves. Atoms localized close to the antinodes of the standing wave can realize phase-controlled quantum operations that are potentially more than an order of magnitude less sensitive to the local optical phase and atomic motion than corresponding travelling wave configurations.

arxiv-2210-04693.title: Beamforming approaches toward detecting the 21-cm global signal from Cosmic Dawn with radio array telescopes DOI: 10.1017/pasa.2020.32
arxiv-2210-04693.creator: D. C. Price
arxiv-2210-04693.description: Abstract The formation of the first stars and galaxies during ‘Cosmic Dawn’ is thought to have imparted a faint signal onto the 21-cm spin temperature from atomic Hydrogen gas in the early Universe. Observationally, an absorption feature should be measurable as a frequency-dependence in the sky-averaged (i.e. global) temperature at meter wavelengths.

arxiv-2211-11669.title: An elementary approach to the model structure on DG-Lie algebras
arxiv-2211-11669.creator: Emma Lepri
arxiv-2211-11669.description: Abstract . This paper contains an elementary proof of the existence of the classical model structure on the category of unbounded DG-Lie algebras over a field of characteristic zero, with an emphasis on the properties of free and semifree extensions, which are particularly nice cofibrations.

arxiv-2307-05501.title: HIVA: Holographic Intellectual Voice Assistant PubID: pubid: 979-8-3503-3961-1/23/$31.00 ©2023 IEEE
arxiv-2307-05501.creator: Ruslan Isaev, Radmir Gumerov, Gulzada Esenalieva, Remudin Reshid Mekuria, Ermek Doszhanov
arxiv-2307-05501.description: Abstract Holographic Intellectual Voice Assistant (HIVA) aims to facilitate human computer interaction using audiovisual effects and 3D avatar. HIVA provides complete information about the university, including requests of various nature: admission, study issues, fees, departments, university structure and history, canteen, human resources, library, student life and events, information about the country and the city, etc.

arxiv-2309-00401.title: Early Dark Energy beyond slow-roll: implications for cosmic tensions
arxiv-2309-00401.creator: Ravi kumar Sharma, Subinoy Das, Vivian Poulin
arxiv-2309-00401.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Ravi kumar Sharma, Subinoy Das, Vivian Poulin. In this work, we explore the possibility that Early Dark Energy (EDE) is dynamical in nature and study its effect on cosmological observables. We introduce a parameterization of the equation of state allowing for an equation of state w w differing considerably from cosmological constant (cc, w = − 1 w={-1} ) and vary both the initial w i w_{i} as well final w f w_{f} equation of state of the EDE fluid.

arxiv-2411-11371.title: Rethinking Thinking Tokens: Understanding Why They Underperform in Practice
arxiv-2411-11371.creator: Sreeram Vennam, David Valente, David Herel, Ponnurangam Kumaraguru
arxiv-2411-11371.description: Abstract Thinking Tokens (TT) Herel and Mikolov 2023 have been proposed as an unsupervised method to facilitate reasoning in language models. However, despite their conceptual appeal, our findings show that TTs marginally improves performance and consistently underperforms compared to Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning across multiple benchmarks.

arxiv-2501-10954.title: Interactive Multiscale Modeling to Bridge Atomic Properties and Electrochemical Performance in Li-CO 2 Battery Design
arxiv-2501-10954.creator: Mohammed Lemaalem a,b , Selva Chandrasekaran Selvaraj a,b , Ilias Papailias c , Naveen K. Dandu a,b , Arash Namaeighasemi a , Larry A. Curtiss b,∗ , Amin Salehi-Khojin c,∗ , and Anh T. Ngo a,b,∗
arxiv-2501-10954.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Mohammed Lemaalem a,b , Selva Chandrasekaran Selvaraj a,b , Ilias Papailias c , Naveen K. Dandu a,b , Arash Namaeighasemi a , Larry A. Curtiss b,∗ , Amin Salehi-Khojin c,∗ , and Anh T. Ngo a,b,∗. Li-CO 2 batteries are promising energy storage systems due to their high theoretical energy density and CO 2 fixation capability, relying on reversible Li 2 CO 3 /C formation during discharge/charge cycles.

arxiv-2503-00979.title: Dialogue Without Limits: Constant-Sized KV Caches for Extended Responses in LLMs
arxiv-2503-00979.creator: Ravi Ghadia, Avinash Kumar, Gaurav Jain, Prashant Nair, Poulami Das
arxiv-2503-00979.description: Abstract Autoregressive Transformers rely on Key-Value (KV) caching to accelerate inference. However, the linear growth of the KV cache with context length leads to excessive memory consumption and bandwidth constraints. Existing methods drop distant tokens or compress states in a lossy manner, sacrificing accuracy by discarding vital context or introducing bias.

arxiv-2504-13136.title: Freezing of the renormalized one-loop primordial scalar power spectrum
arxiv-2504-13136.creator: Matteo Braglia 1 , and Lucas Pinol 2
arxiv-2504-13136.description: Abstract The predictive power of cosmic inflation hinges on the existence of a conserved quantity at very large scales, called the primordial curvature perturbation, which is therefore insensitive to the details of reheating and the physics of the hot Big Bang.

arxiv-2505-17120.title: Self-Interpretability: LLMs Can Describe Complex Internal Processes that Drive Their Decisions
arxiv-2505-17120.creator: Dillon Plunkett, Adam Morris, Keerthi Reddy, Jorge Morales
arxiv-2505-17120.description: Abstract We have only limited understanding of how and why large language models (LLMs) respond in the ways that they do. Their neural networks have proven challenging to interpret, and we are only beginning to tease out the function of individual neurons and circuits within them.

britannica-1911-pont-robert.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-pont-robert.description: Article 'Pont, Robert' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 22), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. born at Vienne, department of Isére, on the 1st of June 1814. He was bred a lawyer, and his first performance in literature was a translation of Manfred (1837). His play Lucrèce was represented at the Théâtre Français on the 1st of April 1843. This date is a kind of epoch in literature and dramatic history, because it marked a reaction against the romantic style of Dumas and Hugo.

pmc-10695924.title: An investigation on humans’ sensitivity to environmental temperature
pmc-10695924.creator: Laura Battistel, Andrea Vilardi, Massimiliano Zampini, Riccardo Parin
pmc-10695924.description: While earlier investigations into thermal perception focused on measuring the detection of temperature changes across distinct bodily regions, the complex nature of thermal perception throughout the entire body remains a subject of ongoing exploration. To address this, we performed an experiment using four climate chambers with oscillating temperatures between 24 °C ± 1 °C.

pmc-11712916.title: Human cerebrospinal fluid extracellular vesicle miRNAs identify sex‐dependent changes in synaptic proteins in postmortem Alzheimer’s disease brain
pmc-11712916.creator: Ursula S Sandau, Trevor J McFarland, Naly Setthavongsack, Sierra J Smith, Douglas R Galasko, Joseph F Quinn, Randy L Woltjer, Julie A Saugstad
pmc-11712916.description: BackgroundAlzheimer’s disease (AD) is the fifth leading cause of death for individuals aged 65 and older. Since FDA approved therapies have limited efficacy, there is a need to develop new treatments based on a better understand of pathological changes occurring in tissues from humans with AD.

pmc-12458703.title: A Mild Alkaline Hydrothermal Etchant for MBene Exfoliation
pmc-12458703.creator: Yiren Zhang, Abraham A. Rosenberg, Joseph T. Doane, William Rice, Alma Kolakji, Michael T. Yeung
pmc-12458703.description: MoBene (the boride equivalent of MXenes) has been a synthetic challenge because borides degrade in common etching media. Inspired by the intercalation of lithium ions into AlOOH, we hypothesized that a hydrothermal route enables lithium ions to intercalate the aluminum layer of MoAlB and further separate the MoB sheet apart.

pmc-12596373.title: Mortality and Causes of Death in Patients With Mycobacterium avium Complex Isolates Through 28 Years
pmc-12596373.creator: Victor N Dahl, Andreas A Pedersen, Isik S Johansen, Michael H Ibsen, Andreas Fløe, Anders Løkke, Ole Hilberg, Aase B Andersen, Christian M Wejse, Troels Lillebaek
pmc-12596373.description: BackgroundNontuberculous mycobacterial (NTM) disease, predominantly caused by Mycobacterium avium complex (MAC), is an emerging global health concern. The evidence regarding MAC-specific mortality and causes of death remains limited. This study investigated mortality and causes of death among patients with MAC isolates.MethodsA nationwide study in Denmark (1991–2018) included all patients with MAC isolates, excluding those identified using gastric lavages alone.

pmc-12785098.title: Effect of Wet Aging on the Meat Quality of Two Cuts (Longissimus thoracis et lumborum and Quadriceps femoris) from Italian Local Goat Breeds Compared to the Saanen Cosmopolitan Breed
pmc-12785098.creator: Marica Egidio, Marika Di Paolo, Federica Capano, Sophia Alesio, Carmen Cabato, Roberta Matera, Matteo Santinello, Lucia Sepe, Raffaele Marrone
pmc-12785098.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Simple SummaryGoat meat is a lean, highly nutritious source of high-quality protein, vitamins, minerals, and an interesting nutritional profile of fats, although its consumption remains limited in Europe. This study aimed to describe the quality characteristics of local kid goat meat (Garganica, Derivata di Siria, and Capra di Potenza) and cosmopolitan breed meat (Saanen) and to evaluate how a short wet aging period affects its nutritional and sensory traits.

pmc-13081490.title: Prevalence and antimicrobial susceptibility profiles of Klebsiella Pneumoniea isolated from cases of bovine mastitis in Maya City, Eastern Hararghe, Ethiopia
pmc-13081490.creator: Bilisumma Mohammedyakob Kedir, Chala Mohammed, Abdallahi Abdurahman, Teshita Edaso Beriso
pmc-13081490.description: A cross-sectional study was carried out from November 2023 to May 2024 on lactating dairy cows in Maya city, in the eastern part of Ethiopia, with the aim of estimating mastitis prevalence, isolate Klebsiella pneumoniea and determine antibiotic resistance profiles of the isolates. A total of 281 animals were selected for screening of mastitis.

pmc-13199584.title: PD-1 blockade plus tyrosine kinase inhibitor remodels the tumor microenvironment in advanced renal cell carcinoma
pmc-13199584.creator: Liangyou Gu, Qi Zhang, Qiyang Liang, Cheng Peng, Yaohui Wang, Chenfeng Wang, Zhuoran Li, Yezhen Tan, Yanming Zhou, Qing Bi, Xiubin Li, Jin Luo, Qingbo Huang, Yan Huang, Xu Zhang, Xin Ma, Weimin Ci, Baojun Wang
pmc-13199584.description: The combination of tyrosine kinase inhibitors (TKIs) and immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) has improved clinical outcomes in advanced renal cell carcinoma (aRCC), though therapeutic resistance remains a major challenge. We conducted single-cell transcriptomic analysis on 61 tumor samples from 34 aRCC patients treated with TKIs alone or in combination with ICIs.
